About Phi Partners 
 Phi Partners has been a trusted capital markets consultancy for more than 20 years, providing quantitative and technology expertise across front office, pricing and risk. We support more than 80 financial institutions across the buy-side and sell-side through niche capabilities spanning quant, engineering, vendor platforms and cloud infrastructure. Our teams work on complex, real-world problems across models, analytics, applications, data and cloud infrastructure, within an international delivery organisation built around regional hubs and specialist centres of excellence. At Phi Partners, our consultants work on some of the industry's most demanding programmes, with opportunities to develop deep expertise in capital markets technology and contribute to diverse client engagements over time.
 About the Client Programme 
 Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, and Phi Partners has supported this organisation for over a decade across Front Office Quant, Pricing & Risk, Vendor Platforms, and Core Technology. We are now hiring C++ Developers to be embedded within the bank’s Change-the-Bank function, focusing on the stabilisation and ongoing changes of a crown jewel application at the heart of the bank's Repo and Securities Lending operations.
 The application is the primary position and pricing hub for the Central Funding Group, interfacing with over 100 downstream risk and pricing systems across seven global regions and running approximately 1,000 daily reports. Built on a mature C++, Java and Python stack – the system is underpinned by vendor technology. Accumulated data volume and the complexity of intraday and end-of-day processing have created performance and stability challenges that this team will be tasked with resolving.
 This is a multi-year engagement. The initial mandate is production stabilisation - a soft landing environment with over 80 consultants already working through Phi Partners with business critical teams. Once the application is stable, consultants will rotate into adjacent workstreams covering expanded domains such as Prime Brokerage and further Change-the-Bank initiatives, providing strong medium-term career continuity within a technically demanding capital markets environment.
 Role & Responsibilities 
 This is a Senior C++ Engineering role for an experienced developer who can take ownership of complex technical challenges within a high-throughput capital markets application. The focus is on resolving challenging performance and stability issues across the C++ core and Oracle database layer, contributing to platform reliability and ongoing engineering improvements.
 Responsibilities include:
Take ownership of the analysis, debugging and resolution of complex production defects within the C++ core of a high-throughput, real-time position and pricing platform
Improve C++ performance and stability, addressing memory management, processing bottlenecks and inefficient data handling within a mature production system
Analyse and optimise Oracle queries and stored procedures where database interactions contribute to application performance issues
Contribute to code quality, testing practices and diagnostic approaches to ensure robust and maintainable solutions
Support regression testing and unit test coverage, ensuring fixes do not introduce instability into a platform connecting over 100 downstream systems
Collaborate closely with the embedded engineering team and the client's internal development and quantitative teams across a globally distributed organisation
Investigate and resolve connectivity and timing issues where upstream delays affect intraday and end-of-day calculation workflows
Contribute to improvements in batch scheduling and scripting infrastructure as part of broader platform stabilisation initiatives
Work independently to investigate complex technical issues, propose solutions and deliver improvements in line with established engineering standards
 Key Skills 
 Essential
Minimum 5 years of C++ engineering experience, with a strong background in production-grade systems, debugging, optimising and modifying complex legacy code
Ability to work independently and take technical ownership of challenging engineering problems within a small team
Proficiency in Oracle databases, including SQL query optimisation and stored procedure debugging
Scripting experience in languages such as Perl, Bash or Python for diagnostics, troubleshooting and automation
Experience with batch processing and job scheduling
Practical experience writing unit tests and working with regression testing frameworks
Experience using Jira or equivalent tools to manage technical issues through investigation, code fixes and release
 Desirable
Capital markets domain knowledge, particularly in Repo, Securities Lending or Prime Brokerage
Exposure to Java development
Experience with APEX or similar vendor platforms
Familiarity with Grafana or equivalent monitoring and observability tools
Experience with CI/CD pipelines in a financial services environment
 Next Steps 
 This is an excellent opportunity for Senior C++ Engineers looking to work on a technically complex, high-impact capital markets platform within one of the world's leading financial institutions. If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career aspirations, please share your CV at ashutosh.pawar@phipartners.com. Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
